result.title: InsightRAG: Aggregating Distributed Scholarly Judgments for Scientific Survey Generation
result.summary: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes survey writing increasingly challenging, motivating automatic survey generation. Yet, existing systems must search an open space of papers and an open space of concepts with no trace of how the community itself has navigated them, leading to incomplete scope, weak taxonomies, and unreliable citations. Our core insight is that author-written Related Work sections contain the human judgments needed to address both limitations: authors curate the citations relevant to their contributions and explain how the cited works relate, yielding paths for scope reconstruction and relational evidence for organization. We propose InsightRAG. Its insight-guided retrieval follows author-supported citation relations to reconstruct a verified research scope and structure the resulting relational evidence. It aggregates these judgments under a minimum-conflict objective into a taxonomy that reflects recurring author-written perspectives in the retrieved literature, guides generation, and bounds each section's evidence. Results on ten topics show gains in scope reconstruction, taxonomy quality, citation support, and reference reliability.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 InsightRAG，用论文 Related Work 中作者自写的引用关系重建研究范围、组织关系证据，并以最小冲突目标聚合为分类体系来指导科学综述生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域距离较远，但其「用关系证据约束每节生成的证据边界」以及聚合分散判断形成组织结构的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与证据充分性判定提供参照，值得核查。
